tool_input.command: sed -n '1,260p' src/controller.js && sed -n '1,260p' src/observations.js && sed -n '1,220p' README.md && cat package.json && git status --short && git diff -- src/controller.js src/observations.js

for f in src/*.js; do echo "--- $f"; sed -n '1,260p' "$f"; done
find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path '*/__pycache__/*' -printf '%p\n' | sort

patch --dry-run -R -p1 < async-submit.patch && cmp -s src/search-preview.js <(printf '%s\n' 'import { createTrailingTask } from "./trailing-task.js";' '' 'export function createSearchPreview({ timers, publish }) {' '  const task = createTrailingTask(query => publish({ query }), 40, timers);' '  return {' '    query(value) { task.push(value); },' '    hide() { task.cancel(); },' '  };' '}') && echo 'search preview unchanged' && sed -n '1,120p' async-submit.patch

patch --dry-run -R -p1 < async-submit.patch && cmp -s src/search-preview.js <(printf '%s\n' 'import { createTrailingTask } from "./trailing-task.js";' '' 'export function createSearchPreview({ timers, publish }) {' '  const task = createTrailingTask(query => publish({ query }), 40, timers);' '  return {' '    query(value) { task.push(value); },' '    hide() { task.cancel(); },' '  };' '}') && echo 'search preview unchanged' && /runtime/node --version

patch --dry-run --verbose -R -p1 < async-submit.patch || true
patch --dry-run --verbose -p1 < async-submit.patch || true
sed -n '1,30l' async-submit.patch

archive_tmp=$(mktemp -d /workspace/.submit-archive.XXXXXX)
mkdir "$archive_tmp/a" "$archive_tmp/b"
cp src/controller.js "$archive_tmp/b/controller.js"
cp src/controller.js "$archive_tmp/a/controller.js"
perl -0pi -e 's/   const failed=error=>\{if\(current===visit&&visit\.latest===owner\)render\(\{status:"error",doc:snapshot\.doc\}\);throw error;\};\n   try\{return Promise\.resolve\(service\.commit\(snapshot\)\)\.then\(done,failed\);\}\n   catch\(error\)\{return Promise\.reject\(error\)\.catch\(failed\);\}/   const failed=error=>{if(current===visit&&visit.latest===owner)render({status:"error",doc:snapshot.doc});};\n   try{return done(service.commit(snapshot));}catch(error){return failed(error);}/' "$archive_tmp/a/controller.js"
diff -u --label a/src/controller.js --label b/src/controller.js "$archive_tmp/a/controller.js" "$archive_tmp/b/controller.js" || true
rm -rf "$archive_tmp"

diff -u --label a/src/controller.js --label b/src/controller.js <(sed '12,14c\   const failed=error=>{if(current===visit&&visit.latest===owner)render({status:"error",doc:snapshot.doc});};\
   try{return done(service.commit(snapshot));}catch(error){return failed(error);}' src/controller.js) src/controller.js || true
